reviews.text: Wonderful with old dogs, gentle and thorough. My poodle mix is always happy and clean with bows in her hair when I pick her up. They've even alerted me to a health issue.
I love this place!  My pups love this place!  One of the greatest gems in San Pedro….  You know, for people with dogs. The staff are awesome. The owner is amazing. 10/10 will recommend.
Amazing staff that you can tell loves animals. They did a wash detailed face cleaning. Expressed anal glands and nail trim at a very reasonable cost. Will definitely be returning

We stopped by their new shop located next to their grooming salon. The shop is full of dog accessories for sale.
The owners were Extremely friendly and nice. My favorite part about their shop was meeting their tiny, soft, friendly, dog.

They did an amazing job on my girl Gigi, she was a mess her coat, nails everything, I forgot who took care of her but they did a great job. And the price is what they told me I would pay, we definitely will be going back!
This place is so friendly and the atmosphere is so welcoming we will definately be back

I was nervous about trying a new groomer, especially when you have a dog that’s part pitbull sometimes she’s super nervous other times rambunctious and I told him about her. They had the owner  do the job himself. She came out so happy and chica wasn’t nervous Or scared.The grooming job was excellent. She smells good. She’s super soft and shiny and it lasts like a month. In addition, the staff is phenomenal. Whoever answers the phone. I wish I remembered her name is just delightful.This place is definitely my new grooming place
Always a perfect job and great service! 🐾 gave my Pup a little toy for Christmas which is her new favorite ❤️

love this place! the staff is awesome & making an appointment is so easy and prices are soo reasonable. I used to take my dog to a different place and she used to pee and freak out leaving, now when I pick her up from here, my dog has no issues. You can tell this is a spot that really cares for the dogs they have in their care.

Got recommended this place in San Pedro. I let the staff know my dog is a little crazy ahead of time and they cleared the route and made sure he didn't see any dogs while we used the self wash station. It gets a little loud from the other grooming areas but that's expected from a busy groomers. Awesome service, super kind and caring staff. They have pretty much everything you need to groom your dog and they even give you aprons and towels in the self wash. I love this place
Easy in and out and helpful staff.

I take my dog here almost every month for both services they offer, and I couldn’t be happier! The self-wash station has everything you need: shampoo, conditioner, other supplies, towels, and a dryer, making it super convenient. They also offer grooming, and I bring my dog in for a de-shedding on special occasions.
I 100% recommend this place!

Our Goldendoodle has a fear of missing out (FOMO) - and a slight bit of anxiety- however all the groomers are amazing and our pup always gets the best care and looks great every time. Henry has been going there about 2 years now.- loves it.!!

One-Star Review for Grooming Service
We've taken our dog to this groomer several times, and generally, things seemed okay. However, we did notice some strange things. For instance, our dog would get incredibly anxious when we approached the doors, crying and begging not to go in, but we just thought he disliked getting groomed. Also, every time, they'd tell us how difficult our dog was to groom, how he misbehaved, and so on, even though he's a small dog with clean fur, a very docile temperament, and incredibly friendly.

Today, they again charged us an extra $50, claiming it was difficult and he behaved poorly. We picked him up crying and whimpering so much that it made us want to cry too. I was puzzled why grooming a small dog was still so expensive and why my dog was crying so much. At home, I started examining their work and saw that almost all of his nails weren't trimmed; they were broken, not even filed down. One was broken lengthwise... a shiver ran down my spine, imagining how much pain my dog must have been in.

This service gets one star!

⸻

I have to agree—the staff and the owner are very friendly, and I really appreciated their warm attitude.

However, I was a bit disappointed with the grooming results. My dog still had an odor on his fur, and one of his ears was noticeably dirty inside. It made me question whether a thorough cleaning was done. I’m also unsure if the rear gland was expressed properly, as there didn’t seem to be any sign that it was.

I value the friendliness, but I hope more attention can be given to the actual grooming details in the future
Very nice groomer

This is an awesome local downtown San Pedro groomer. We have a very terrified, anxious 11 yr. old rottie and Eri(c/k)a was able to handle him and trim his nails. Even the vet could not handle it and said they would need to sedate him in order to trim his nails. At his age we try to avoid that. Thank you to Erica and Adrian! <3

I took my Frenchie a few days ago and she's  still so soft and clean! She was lucky enough to have the owner groom her. He cleaned her wrinkles and even flushed her ears! Definitely will take her back.
They are the best.

Just left my dog and already happy on how they’re treating my dog. My dog is a very aggressive 1 year old puppy and doesn’t like to be groomed. Erica and her team are the best to handle dogs who need extra attention when it comes to haircuts.
Facilities and staff are great! Highly recommend!
Mikhaela helping us with a smile... my Bulky and Duster are sooo happy. Definitely going back.
I take 2 different dogs there and the women there are nice and caring about the 4legged clients
Such an enjoyable place ❤️.

Great place to get your dog washed, the grooming is excellent and if you're willing to diy it they have that option as well for a totally reasonable price that includes shampoo as well as access to a blow dryer & grooming table. Overall, just great customer service and a group of people that obviously love dogs and want to provide a great service.
We absolutely love this place! They are always so good to our Teddy.
